source: docs/specs/06_events/04_endings.md: the lead-up (zin_ending.1 to .4) and the aftermath of each ending (zin_ending.10 to .80). Notation: tools/content/lib/crown_script.mjs.

events.title: The Age Draws to Its Close
events.to: every human player
events.desc: Chroniclers say the Fourth Age is ending. They do not agree how, and they have begun to quarrel in the margins of one another's pages.

options.text: Then let us write its last page.

do.tip: The ends still open to the age:[zin_loc_endings_possible]

events.title: The Last Year of Judgement
events.to: every human player
events.desc: If no crown has ended the age by the first day of 4A 1762, the chroniclers will judge it by what each crown holds. They have already begun to count.

events.title: Shadows Over Parim
events.to: every human player at war with Volgan
events.desc: Volgan's hosts hold Parim, and his client crowns are many. If nothing changes, the world will be his.

events.title: The Ash Gathers
events.to: every human player at war with the realm Afrit leads
events.desc: Afrit holds Parim, and too many crowns owe him their councils. If the palace is not taken, the age will end in ash.

events.title: No Crown Over Crowns
events.to: Eindil's Aenor
events.desc: The king's council asks what Aenor shall ask of the crowns that fought beside it. He answers: nothing they did not offer.

events.title: A Treaty Among Equals
events.to: every coalition member and Free Dominion of Eindil's Aenor
events.desc: Parim offers a treaty of mutual defence between equals. It claims no land and no oath of service. In this telling of the age, the crowns may sign or not.

events.title: Grievances Remain
events.to: western, northern and eastern crowns outside the coalition that do not love the heir
events.desc: The war is over. The old claims are not. Our court remembers what Aenor was before the heir, and what it may be after him.

events.title: First Friends of the King
events.to: every country that keeps the king's regard
events.desc: The king remembers who nursed a stranger from the ice, who made peace beside him, who sheltered him when he was hunted.

do.tip: The crown has already named your court among the First Friends of the King.

events.title: The Necklace at His Throat
events.to: Eindil's Aenor, if the king wears the necklace
events.desc: The king still wears the necklace he took from his brother. He does not speak of it, and nobody asks him to.

events.title: The Houses Without a God
events.to: every country the Houses of the First Light still reach
events.desc: The Houses of the First Light still keep grain and hospitals. Their god is dead. In this telling of the age, each crown must decide what they are now.

options.text: Keep them as the crown's hospitals.
Let them go on as they are.

events.title: The Court of Nafeher
events.to: Volgan
events.desc: The lords of the Dominion kneel in the hall of Nafeher. The world is his, as he always said it would be once men divided.

options.text: Let the clients rule in my name.

events.title: A Client Crown
events.to: every subject of Volgan
events.desc: Our crown is a gift of Nafeher now. Our people have stopped asking whose.

events.title: The Dark Over Parim
events.to: every Aenor realm and the Host of Eindil
events.desc: Parim belongs to the south. Those of Aen's kingdom who still fight do so from the hills and the lakes.

events.title: A Ruined World
events.to: every country that is not Volgan, his subject or Zol
events.desc: The trade roads are empty and the harbours are full of people who have nowhere to go. Every court is learning how little a crown is worth without a market.

events.title: The Worshipped King
events.to: the realm Afrit leads
events.desc: The council asks how the King of All Aoaz will rule a world that knows his name.

options.text: As a king; let them forget the rest.

events.title: The Temple Asks Its Due
events.to: every country with deep footholds, except the realm Afrit leads
events.desc: Our councillors owe the temples of Afrit favours older than our grandfathers. Now the temples ask openly.

events.title: The Ash Settles
events.to: every country with shallow footholds, except the realm Afrit leads and its subjects
events.desc: A false god rules the old kingdom of Aen. Our court must decide whether to bow, or to wait.

options.text: Close our borders to his priests.
Send gifts and keep our counsel.

events.title: The King's Long Feast
events.to: the Aenor realm
events.desc: The old King holds a feast for the end of the war. He laughs louder than anyone, and the candles of the Golden Court burn until dawn.

variants.text: The old King holds a feast for the end of the war, and he laughs louder than anyone. He eats nothing his tasters have not touched.

events.title: The Temples and the King
events.to: the Worshipdom, if the Council rules through the King
events.desc: The King reigns. The Council governs. Nobody outside this room knows the difference.

options.text: So it has been, and so it will be.

events.title: Governors of the Old Kingdom
events.to: the crown that holds Parim
events.desc: Our captains govern the oldest city of men. They do not know the language of its prayers.

events.title: Aenor Beyond Parim
events.to: every Aenor realm
events.desc: The kingdom has lost its capital to the West. The Concord meets in exile, and the empty chair of the Speaker is turned to face the lake.

events.title: The Chain at Sonargur
events.to: Lerendor
events.desc: The harbour chain of Sonargur is raised for every ship. The toll of 4A 1716 is paid a thousand times over.

events.title: Northern Dues
events.to: the crowns of the North Lands and every Aenor realm
events.desc: Our ships pay Lerendor's dues now, in the same coin and at the same quay that once humbled its envoys.

events.title: Master of All Roads
events.to: the united crown of the East
events.desc: Every caravan from the rift to the deep sand pays one treasury.

events.title: Homage to the High King
events.to: every East Lands court except the united crown
events.desc: The High King's envoys ask for homage. They have brought the old words, and a very large chair.

events.title: The League Without the Heir
events.external: zin_eindil.140 reaches it fourteen days after the heir is lost, through zin_ending_heir_lost
events.to: the Host of Eindil, else the Aenor realm holding Parim, else the original Aenor country
events.desc: The heir is gone. The league he gathered is still in the field, and the dark has not gone home.

then.tip: A worthy crown may seek Glo as its bearer.
